findings.title: §2.5 recovers the worktree target from a durable binding that does not exist — the binding is columns on the sessions row, so the §6 A RED fixture is not constructible and the operation path can never reach `completed`
findings.detail:
New in round 2. §2.5 line 78 says "worktree 从原 gate-entry owner 的 `getWorktreeBinding` / durable workflow binding 恢复… 旧 operation 缺该元数据时只从 durable binding 反查唯一 exact issue/run owner", and line 79's RED fixture requires "所有 StateStore/CommDB session 行均删，但 operation/run/attribution/**binding**/merge receipt 保留" while asserting the new wiring reaches "inventory→CommDB→**worktree**→archive→Done→completed". No such durable binding exists:

- `StateStore.getWorktreeBinding(executionId)` (packages/teamlead/src/StateStore.ts:24981-24994) is `SELECT worktree_binding_path AS p, worktree_binding_branch AS b, worktree_binding_generation AS g, worktree_binding_locked_at AS l, … FROM sessions WHERE execution_id = ?`. Path/branch/generation are columns ON the sessions row.
- There is no table with `worktree` in its name (`grep -on 'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS [a-z_]*worktree[a-z_]*' StateStore.ts` → zero hits).
- `workflow_execution_binding` (StateStore.ts:5776-5787) carries only activation_id/execution_id/run_id/node_id/attempt/mode/rework_request_id/bound_at — no path, branch or generation.
- `land_operation` has no worktree columns.

So deleting the sessions rows deletes the binding with them: the fixture at line 79 cannot be built as written, and on the real operation path `worktreeBinding` is always absent. worktree-cleanup.ts:180-198's only other target source is `expectedWorktree(projectRoot, projectName, deriveWorktreeKey(ident, session?.session_role))`, which §3 line 82 explicitly forbids ("不能猜 issue slug 然后把猜测路径缺失当成功"). Every target therefore resolves to `worktree_target_unresolved`, and §3 line 83 accepts only `removed` or proven `absent` — so `worktreeRemoved` stays false, `landReady` stays false (post-ship-finalization.ts:1106-1112, 1156), and the chain stops before terminal notification, archive, Linear Done and `completed`. The gate that is supposed to verify the round-1 HIGH fix can never go green as specified.

Separately, §2.5 offers no `worktree_not_applicable` disposition for the §2.1 `adapter=engine` / never-launched shape (FLY-2588's land@1), which by construction never had a worktree and must not be blocked on an unresolvable target.

Required: state where an operation-durable worktree target actually lives — either persist path/branch/generation at land-intent time onto `land_operation` (or a new additive table, with its FLY-2006 fragment) as a mandatory, not optional, step, and say what happens to operations created before that migration; and add an explicit `worktree_not_applicable` disposition with the exact conditions under which finalization may proceed with no worktree attestation. Note that "新 intent 可把已验证 binding ID 固定到 existing operation metadata" is currently optional ("可"), covers only new intents, and references a "binding ID" that no table issues.
findings.failure_scenario: Implementer builds §6 A's RED fixture: delete all StateStore + CommDB session rows for the issue, keep operation/run/attribution/merge receipt. `getWorktreeBinding` returns undefined for every execution (its SELECT targets the deleted sessions row) and `workflow_execution_binding` has no path, so `resolveLandFinalizationContext` yields `worktreeBinding: undefined` → `worktree_target_unresolved`. post-ship-finalization refuses to set worktreeRemoved, landReady stays false, and the test's asserted `land_operation=completed, thread.archived=true, Linear state.type=completed` never occurs. The implementer's likely workaround — deriving the path from the issue slug via `expectedWorktree` — is exactly the unsafe behaviour §3 forbids.

findings.title: The operation path allows `sourceExecutionId: null` but every audit/event write targets a NOT NULL execution_id column
findings.detail: New in round 2. §2.5 line 77 specifies "event/notification 幂等键以 operationId 为 anchor，不能用随机替代 executionId；可空 source ID 只用于 attribution". That fixes the dedupe key but not the storage constraint: `session_events.execution_id` is `TEXT NOT NULL` (packages/teamlead/src/StateStore.ts:6197-6208), and the writes on this path all supply one — worktree-cleanup.ts:139-148 `audit()` builds `event_id: worktree-cleanup-${input.executionId}-${eventKey}` with `execution_id: input.executionId`, and `WorktreeCleanupInput.executionId` (worktree-cleanup.ts:70) is required. With `sourceExecutionId: null` there is no value to write. The plan does not say where operation-scoped audit rows live, so an implementer will most likely stuff the operationId into the `execution_id` column, minting a synthetic execution identity in a table the plan elsewhere insists must carry only full real identities (§2 "显示名称不参与身份；所有写操作用完整 project/issue UUID/run/exec/activation/代次"). State the destination explicitly: either make the operation path write to an operation-keyed table/column, or require `sourceExecutionId` to be non-null for any path that emits audit events and define what happens when the gate-entry attribution is missing.
findings.failure_scenario: Operation-path finalization runs with `sourceExecutionId: null`. `insertEvent` rejects on the NOT NULL constraint, or the implementer writes `execution_id = <operationId>`; from then on `session_events` contains rows whose execution_id is not an execution, and any later forensic or attribution query that joins on that column silently mixes operation ids into execution identity.

findings.title: Round-1 arithmetic fixed; residual: no stated bound on the cross-exec batch, so "archive 前全体更新 freshness" still has no feasibility argument
findings.detail: Resolved as filed. §2.2 now uses per-observation 30s measured at completion, per-probe ≤5s, per-exec bounded-concurrency budget ≤10s, timeout→unknown, and only stale observations are re-probed — which is consistent with the real probe timeouts (tmux-lookup.ts:26 `TMUX_TIMEOUT = 5000`; generalized-launch-recovery.ts:33 `pgrep -f` `{timeout: 5_000}`) and no longer self-contradictory. It also now fails closed with `probe_budget_exceeded` + backoff/escalation instead of looping. Residual, non-blocking: "跨 exec 使用有界批次…archive 前全体更新 freshness" names no batch width and no inventory-size ceiling, so for a wide inventory the all-observations-within-30s precondition at archive time may still be unreachable in practice. Worth stating the batch bound (or the N above which the plan expects `probe_budget_exceeded` to be the normal outcome) so the escalation path is a designed state rather than a surprise.
findings.failure_scenario: An issue with a large execution inventory on a loaded host: each batch refreshes some observations while earlier ones cross 30s, so the archive-time whole-set freshness check keeps emitting `probe_budget_exceeded` and the closeout escalates rather than completing — correct and safe, but the plan gives no guidance on where that boundary sits.
